name: Passive offshore vehicle or foundation holding personal assets
description: A foundation, shell or similar vehicle in a low-transparency jurisdiction holds an individual's investments, property or accounts without commercial purpose.
fp: Wealth-planning vehicles are common among legitimate high-net-worth clients; confirm purpose and ownership.
